findings.label: Non-permission CameraException copy
findings.description: The else branch in _initCamera() sets _cameraError to the food-recognition error voice ('Oops. I couldn't tell what that is. Try another angle?') instead of e.description ?? 'Camera unavailable.' A hardware camera error will show a recognition-failure message that gives no actionable guidance.
findings.action: Replace the else branch value with: e.description ?? 'Camera unavailable.'

findings.label: Running-camera Nova loses caption on initialization
findings.description: The pre-init Nova overlay correctly passes caption: 'Point me at your plate.' but the cameraReady overlay omits caption. Once the camera initializes, the scanning prompt disappears — the opposite of when users most need it.
findings.action: Add caption: 'Point me at your plate.' to the cameraReady Nova when _novaViewfinderState == NovaState.idle.
